description: This header file defines utility functions within the Utils namespace for file synchronization and JSON settings persistence, including functions to synchronize file state and to persist JSON settings to a file.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes the contents of a file with the underlying storage by opening the file, flushing buffers, and calling fsync.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists JSON settings to a specified file, updating the JSON object and ensuring data is written to disk.

ctags.name: persistJsonSettings

ctags.signature: (const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
